# QurilishERP

> QurilishERP — qurilish (construction) kompaniyalari uchun ERP boshqaruv tizimi (Uzbekistan). Veb-sayt, Android ilova va Windows/macOS dasturi orqali ishlaydi. Obyektlar (loyihalar), smeta, materiallar va ombor hisobi, xarajat/kirim, ishchilar davomati (GPS nazorat bilan), maosh hisoblash, elektron hujjat va imzo, AI yordamchi hamda Telegram bot integratsiyasini bitta tizimda beradi.

QurilishERP is a construction-company ERP (enterprise resource planning) platform built for the Uzbekistan market, available as a website, Android app, and Windows/macOS desktop app. It digitizes site/project management, cost estimation (smeta), materials and warehouse accounting, expense/income tracking, worker attendance with GPS check-in, payroll, e-signature documents, an AI assistant, and a Telegram bot — in one system.

## Asosiy imkoniyatlar (Key features)

- Obyekt (loyiha) boshqaruvi — construction site/project management
- Smeta tahlili (Excel'dan import) — cost estimate analysis
- Materiallar va ombor hisobi — materials and warehouse accounting
- Xarajat va kirim hisobi — expense and income tracking
- Ishchilar davomati va GPS nazorat — worker attendance with GPS check-in
- Maosh hisoblash — payroll calculation
- Elektron hujjat va imzo (shartnoma, dalolatnoma, yuk xati) — e-signature documents
- 1C uchun eksport — export for 1C accounting software
- Real-time chat va bildirishnomalar
- AI yordamchi (ovozli va matnli)
- Telegram bot integratsiyasi

## Platformalar (Platforms)

- Veb-sayt: https://erp-firma.uz/
- Android ilova
- Windows va macOS desktop dastur

## Kimlar uchun (Who it's for)

Qurilish firmalari, pudratchilar, prorablar va qurilish loyihalarini boshqaruvchi tashkilotlar (Uzbekistan).
Construction companies, contractors, site managers (prorab), and organizations managing construction projects in Uzbekistan.
